name: notice-board-visit-threshold-2-v1
description: ⭐ THE THRESHOLD SWEEP, LOW END (Dean, 10/09/2026, §5 of docs/notice-board-visit-handoff-2026-09-10-v2.md). ONE LEAF CHANGES against overlays/notice-board-visit-v1.overlay.json and it is rules.economy.noticeBoardThreshold, 3 to 2: the owner may harvest their Notice Board as soon as it holds TWO cards rather than three. Everything else is the arm, pinned leaf for leaf, and rules.economy.noticeBoardBlocks stays false, so this is still a MINIMUM and never a maximum - the board keeps accepting cards for ever and nothing refuses a play. THE QUESTION IT ANSWERS, in Dean's own framing: the threshold is what the host is PAID, so at 2 THE OWNER'S HARVEST IS BARELY WORTH AN ACTION. The whole payment in this design is material the host must still convert - two cards into a barn, for a whole Harvest action - and if that trade is bad the host is not really being paid at all, which is the fault the Lopiano lens found in all seven previous versions of the bonus. ⚠️ THE FAULT IT IS LOOKING FOR IS NOT A RATE BUT A REFUSAL TO CASH IN: watch a20, how often a board sits at or above its threshold unharvested and for how long. A low threshold that nobody bothers to harvest is the same stall as a blocking board, arrived at from the other side, and it would show as boards drifting to five and six cards while their owners spend actions on anything else. READ IT IN THIS ORDER: (1) a20, the stall, and the median size of a board WHEN IT IS HARVESTED, which is the number that says what the threshold actually rations - if the median is already 4 at a threshold of 3, then 2 is a no-op and this is the cap-of-two lesson of 05/09/2026 arriving a third time (⛔ A CAP SET BELOW WHAT THE PILE ACTUALLY REACHES IS NOT A LEVER). (2) Harvests of a Notice Board per player per game, against harvests of an ordinary building - the arm's own farm engine is what a cheap board harvest competes with. (3) THE FARM BYPASS, REDEFINED: what share of barn cards arrived as somebody else's fee. A lower threshold turns the board into a faster faucet into the host's barn, so this is where a cheap harvest shows up as a design change rather than a tuning. (4) The bonus rate on the turn measure and the self-visit share, because a board you can cash in sooner is a board it is cheaper to feed yourself. (5) Barn glut and deliveries per player. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors, reference-v15 seeds), paired against the arm and against overlays/notice-board-visit-threshold-4-v1.overlay.json on identical seeds; read the three as a ladder and never a single arm against the shipped commons. The engine's hand limit of 7 is the simulator's bound and not a rule of the game (C7). ⛔ PINNED AT dairyGrowsBuilt 'none' ON 12/09/2026, WHEN THE BASE MOVED TO 'paidWild'. Every number published off this arm was measured BEFORE Dean ruled the Dairy board's follow-on Grow in, so the pin is what keeps this file reproducing what it measured. A new arm that wants the ruled rule should say so by name. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⚠️ 13/09/2026: rules.economy.noticeBoardsBySeats.2 1 is pinned here because the shipped defaults flipped when the commons was deleted, so this arm stays the game it was. ⛔ APIARY PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the Apiary board's retext in as the shipped default (apiaryPower 'deckGrowWild', "Grow a building using the top card of any deck", the deck card paying any activation cost). This overlay predates it, so apiaryPower is pinned here BY NAME at 'sow' (the S12 Sow 2) and it still replays its own game. ⛔ DELIVERY MEEPLE PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the delivery meeple ON as the shipped default (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) together with two new island rules, the space choice (rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true: a delivery names either free space) and the closing draw (rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: filling a tile draws one card per crate). This overlay predates it, so all six leaves are pinned here BY NAME at their pre-ruling values (deliveryMeepleSpace null, meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null, meepleSpendDistinctColours false, deliverySpaceChoice false, closingDrawPerCrate 0; 'start' and null are the old inert values, not 'none' and 0) and it still replays its own game. Since 16/09/2026 the balloons, the Aerodrome, the Village Store, the closing draw and the wild substitution are deleted from the engine, so this overlay no longer replays the game it was recorded on. Its pins for the coins arm's two sinks, the balloons and the Aerodrome, the Village Store and the closing draw were removed with them. ⚠️ 16/09/2026, THE TOKEN ISLAND AND THE TURN-ORDER RULINGS: the island is now two tokens per tile (Dean, R3: a first delivery pays both demands and chooses its token, a second pays the last token plus 2 any; Workers sit on the 3 and 4 VP tokens), and the Vegetable and Dairy boards were retexted (R9, R10), so this overlay's pins of rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice, rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace, rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.dairyGrowsBuilt were removed with the delivery spaces and the Dairy board's Grow. It pins rules.economy.noticeBoardPower.vegetableWildCards 0 and dairyDiscount 0 by name, and island.tokens.workerOnVp [] because its game had no island meeple, and it now starts with seat 0 and gives one more turn each (rules.setup.firstPlayer 'seat0', rules.endGame.endOfGame 'oneMoreTurnEach'). It no longer replays the game it was recorded on, and nothing measured before 16/09/2026 is comparable as a level. ⛔ WHEAT BOARD RETEXT PINNED 19/09/2026: this is a sub-arm of notice-board-visit-v1 and must keep an identical leaf set (data.test.ts asserts it), so it pins wheatBarn 1 and wheatHarvestGate 'loaded' for the same reason the parent overlay does - see its description. ⛔ HAND LIMIT PINNED 24/09/2026: the simulator's hand bound moved from 7 to 10 (rules.turn.handLimit is an INSTRUMENT bound, never a table rule, CLAUDE.md 2.3; the move is reasoned in rules.json's meta.notes). This overlay predates that move and replays a game recorded under the bound of 7, so rules.turn.handLimit 7 is pinned here BY NAME and it still replays its own game.
